does: Gives the real position of an entity for the AI, the one saved before any hypothetical move, or the entity's current position when none is saved; FLT_MAX when the entity is gone.

evidence.says: looks the entity up in the saved-position map at +0x308; otherwise the object's position from vtable +0xB8; 0x7F7FFFFF triple on failure
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 5 places, nearly all from +0x312AF90 and +0x3133BE0
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the likeness of the two pseudo-codes
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
